title: AuditEvent
description: Append-only JSONL row recording every write action against the SWA/Functions surface or chat tool surface. Stored under data/audit/*.jsonl. Phase 0 wave 3 — issue #110. REDACTION RULE: prompts, raw errors, args, and payloads MUST NOT appear in this stream.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Consumers MUST reject unknown versions.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the event was recorded.

actor.description: GitHub username (allowlisted operator) who initiated the action.

action.description: Endpoint path (e.g. `/api/ops/redeem`) or chat tool name (e.g. `run_redeem`).

request_id.description: Per-request UUID v4 for log correlation.

workflow.description: Workflow name when the action dispatched one; null otherwise. Field MUST be present even when null.

run_id.description: GitHub Actions run id (as string) when the action dispatched a workflow; null otherwise. Field MUST be present.

correlation_id.description: Cross-system correlation id (matches run-result.correlation_id when a run was started/adopted); null when not applicable. Field MUST be present.

error_code.description: Short machine-readable error code (no message text) when result != ok; null otherwise. Field MUST be present.
